title: PendingComments
description: The pending store of the feedback-events lane (events/pending.json; B37/D5, P32b / P1-8 narrow): comments and edits a human has filed against the draft that no revise round has consumed yet. Rewritten atomically as one document; the round that consumes an entry drops it here and appends the finalized feedback_event to events/events.jsonl. This record holds human work — a file that fails this schema is a typed refusal at every door that touches pending, never rewritten or rebuilt by the engine (B130's rule for human-edited records; B145 §3d).

next_cid.description: The next comment id to mint. MONOTONIC, never derived from the list length: pending shrinks as rounds consume, and a reissued cid once aliased a dismissed guest comment into a consumed internal one.

cid.description: Minted here from next_cid; carried onto the finalized feedback_event so the append-only record names each consumed item exactly once (P1-14).

kind.description: Only comments and edits pend — every other feedback kind appends immediately because it is complete the moment it happens.

provenance.description: internal = the pursuit team; external = a share-link guest (D16a). An external entry reaches a round only once an operator has included it (included_by).

slot_id.description: Path A: the answer slot the entry addresses; absent for a section-level entry.

actor.description: The session identity for internal entries; `share:<link_id>:<display name>` for a guest — the prefix IS the structural unverified marker (D16a).

actor_role.description: One of feedback-event.schema.json's actor_role vocabulary — that schema is the vocabulary's single home and the door enforces it (events.py reads ACTOR_ROLES from it at import); not duplicated here (B145 §3b).

at.description: Server clock (P0-11: the client never supplies a clock).

revision.description: The envelope revision the entry was filed against.

text.description: A comment's text (required by the door for kind = comment).

before.description: An edit's anchor — the exact text the round replaces, verbatim (required by the door for kind = edit).

edit_reason.description: One of feedback-event.schema.json's edit_reason vocabulary (the door enforces it; see actor_role).

link_id.description: Guest entries: the public share-link id the comment arrived through.

display_name.description: Guest entries: the name the guest typed — self-declared, never verified.

screen_flags.description: Guest entries: what the injection screen found in the text (P26a); carried onto the round record as external_screen_flags when the entry is consumed.

included_by.description: D16d: the operator who included a guest entry into the next round — the affirmative human act; without it an external entry is never consumed.

dismissed_by.description: D16d: the operator who dismissed a guest entry; the round records its event id under dismissed_external_event_ids and drops it.
